description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractUploadManager' that encapsulates the execution logic for multipart uploads to AWS S3 or Glacier, including methods for initiating, managing, and completing uploads asynchronously with promise-based concurrency control.

classes.name: AbstractUploadManager
classes.description: An abstract base class for managing multipart uploads to AWS storage services, providing core logic for initiation, progress, completion, error handling, and concurrency management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the upload manager with an AWS client and configuration, loading workflow info and determining initial state.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current upload state object.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Executes the upload process synchronously by waiting for the promise to resolve.

methods.name: promise
methods.description: Begins the multipart upload asynchronously, setting up command pools and handling errors.

methods.name: transformException
methods.description: Converts AWS exceptions into specific multipart upload exceptions.

methods.name: buildFailureCatch
methods.description: Creates a callback for catching and transforming errors during promise execution.

methods.name: loadUploadWorkflowInfo
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented for providing workflow info key data.

methods.name: determinePartSize
methods.description: Abstract method to determine optimal part size based on source and config.

methods.name: handleResult
methods.description: Abstract method to process the response after uploading a part.

methods.name: getInitiateParams
methods.description: Abstract method to generate parameters for initiating the upload.

methods.name: getCompleteParams
methods.description: Abstract method to generate parameters for completing the upload.

methods.name: determineState
methods.description: Creates or retrieves the current upload state object, initializing it with provided identifiers.

methods.name: execCommand
methods.description: Executes a specific AWS command asynchronously with pre- and post-processing.

methods.name: getResultHandler
methods.description: Provides a callback handler to process responses and errors from upload commands.

methods.name: getUploadCommands
methods.description: Abstract generator method yielding upload part commands.
